fastagency.verdict: Open-source framework that deploys multi-agent AI workflows to production as APIs and web apps.

Developers write their agentic workflows once using AG2 (formerly AutoGen), and FastAgency serves them as console apps, web chat interfaces or REST APIs — or scales them across datacenters via NATS message brokers with only a few lines of configuration. fetchsandbox.verdict: Verifies your software still behaves correctly when dependencies fail — the cases CI never catches.
overview: FetchSandbox verifies that your software keeps its promises when things go wrong: timeouts, retries, duplicate webhooks, and overlapping jobs. You define invariants — rules that must always hold, like 'a retry must not charge twice' — and it tests them in isolated environments with injected failures. A free integration engine with mock twins of popular APIs plugs into Cursor or Claude Code via MCP, and every run produces a receipt showing what passed, what failed, and what stayed unverified.

Evidence receipts for every verification run
